_comment: Per-market required params. Each entry overrides default_params.json for that market. Env vars (CORE_MODEL_*) override these at runtime.
_comment_sparklend_sources: SparkLend runs fully live (verified against staging 17 Aug 2026): positions from borrower/borrower_collateral, prices from onchain_token_price, books from cex_orderbook_snapshots. Clusters without indexed data (local kind) override back to parquet via the global CORE_MODEL_*_SOURCE env vars (set in the dev overlay).
_comment_morpho_scope: Live Morpho positions are Ethereum-mainnet Blue markets (contract-total-verified). BA's parquet snapshots for these keys were built from Base's much larger markets (their README routes cbBTC liquidity via a Base pool), so live CRRs will NOT reconcile with parquet-era CRRs: different borrower universe, not a data bug.
_comment_syrup_sources: Fully live in staging (8-9 Sep 2026): positions from the maple_* tables, prices from onchain_token_price (BTC/ETH via the WBTC/WETH proxy series) plus asset_price (XRP/HYPE, token-less), books from cex_orderbook_snapshots. Prod data lags this config (no XRP/HYPE backfill, books BTC/ETH only), so the prod overlay pins these two markets back to parquet via the per-market CORE_MODEL_SYRUP_* env vars until it catches up.
_comment_anchorage_sources: The live positions reader (anchorage_package_snapshot) is implemented and tested, but the upstream Anchorage API has returned zero packages since 2026-06-16 (ARCT-229), so the newest cohort fails the reader's freshness bound in both environments. All three sources stay parquet until the feed resumes; flip them together, because the market frame's oracle_price anchors the simulated paths, so positions, prices and books must describe one coherent moment.

_galaxy_disabled._comment: Galaxy collateral symbols (ETH, SOL, JITOSOL) have no sell-orderbook parquet in inputs/, so this market fails at the liquidity step on every run. Underscore prefix excludes it from the loader. Re-enable by renaming to 'galaxy' once the order books exist (see README, Galaxy section).
